detail.longDescription: We have multiple teams developing pipelines in a shared Azure Data Factory (ADF), connected to a single Azure DevOps Git repository. Problem: When one team deploys to TEST/PROD, other teams' committed but unapproved changes also get deployed. We currently use cherry-picking to avoid this, which is difficult to maintain. Requirements: - One shared ADF per environment. - All development must be done visually in ADF Studio (no VS Code). - Independent PRs and deployments for each team. - Only approved pipelines and their dependencies should be promoted. - No cherry-picking or accidental deployment of other teams' changes. We currently have a separate ADF and Git repo for our team, but need to decommission that ADF and move into the shared instance. Question: What is the recommended Git branching and Azure DevOps CI/CD strategy to achieve independent team deployments from a shared ADF? Can we generate team-specific deployment artifacts from one Git repository, or is there a better supported approach? Please advise Thankyou very much
